proposed_widenings.name: choose_up_to_from_area TargetSelection mode (or targeted_from_area Attachment kind)
proposed_widenings.justification: The secondary bolts target up to 3 chosen creatures within 30 ft of the PRIMARY target, not within the spell's 150 ft cast range. No existing Attachment or TargetSelection shape expresses 'choose up to N targets constrained to proximity of another target.' The area attachment hits all creatures in the sphere (not chosen); the target choose_up_to has no spatial anchor relative to a prior phase's target. Both would produce an incorrect trace.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Three bolts then leap from that target to as many as three other targets of your choice, each of which must be within 30 feet of the first target.

proposed_widenings.name: on_primary_target AreaOrigin already exists — needs composition with TargetSelection
proposed_widenings.justification: The origin concept 'on_primary_target' is already in AreaOrigin (used by area attachment). The missing piece is combining a player-chosen count with a spatially anchored pool. A new TargetSelection mode like { mode: 'choose_up_to_from_area', count: SlotScaling<number>, area: ..., origin: AreaOrigin } would close the gap cleanly without new atoms.
proposed_widenings.evidence: One additional bolt leaps from the first target to another target for each spell slot level above 6.

notes: The activation family with two sequential save_gate phases is exactly right. Phase 1 (primary target, mode: 'one', range 150 ft) fits cleanly with existing types. Phase 2 damage and save atoms exist in v4 (save_gate, damage, scale_die_count). The only missing piece is a surface attachment/selection variant that expresses 'player-chosen subset from within a spatially bounded pool anchored at the previous phase's target.' Higher-level scaling (count: base 3, +1/slot above 6) maps cleanly to SlotScaling<number> once the variant exists.
